name: memoryai-monorepo
description: MemoryAI: Open-source, local-first long-term memory platform for AI agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @memoryai/types && npm run build -w @memoryai/security && npm run build -w @memoryai/observability && npm run build -w @memoryai/embeddings && npm run build -w @memoryai/reranking && npm run build -w @memoryai/context-builder && npm run build -w @memoryai/extraction && npm run build -w @memoryai/memory-engine && npm run build -w @memoryai/consolidation && npm run build -w @memoryai/storage-sqlite && npm run build -w @memoryai/storage-memory-format && npm run build -w @memoryai/core && npm run build -w @memoryai/sdk && npm run build -w @memoryai/mcp && npm run build -w @memoryai/adapter-chatgpt && npm run build -w @memoryai/adapter-claude && npm run build -w @memoryai/adapter-gemini && npm run build -w @memoryai/adapter-cursor && npm run build -w @memoryai/adapter-codex && npm run build -w @memoryai/api && npm run build -w memoryai
scripts.test: node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/memory/*.test.mjs tests/retrieval/*.test.mjs tests/mcp/*.test.mjs tests/security/isolation.test.mjs tests/security/injection-hardening.test.mjs tests/security/ssrf-limits.test.mjs tests/providers/*.test.mjs tests/skills/*.test.mjs tests/import-export/*.test.mjs tests/embeddings/*.test.mjs tests/concurrency/*.test.mjs tests/reliability/*.test.mjs tests/migration/*.test.mjs tests/cli/*.test.mjs tests/dashboard/*.test.mjs tests/performance/*.test.mjs tests/regression/*.test.mjs tests/e2e/*.test.mjs
